## Phantasm (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
CE Medium undead (incorporeal)  
**Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 90 ft., lifesense; Perception +14  
**Aura** unnatural aura (30 ft.)  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 20, flat-footed 16 (+5 deflection, +5 Dex)  
**hp** 65 (5d8+25)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +4, **Will** +6  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +2, incorporeal; **Immune** undead traits  
**Weaknesses** sunlight powerlessness  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 90 ft. (good)  
**Melee** incorporeal touch +3 (1d8 negative energy plus 1d4 Con drain)  


**Statistics**


Str—; **Dex** 20, Con —; **Int** 14; **Wis** 14; **Cha** 21  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 21  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative  
**Skills** Diplomacy +10, Fly +7, Intimidate +13, Perception +14, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +11  
**Languages** Common  


**Special Abilities**


**Constitution Drain (Su)** Creatures hit by a phantasm’s touch attack must succeed on a DC 15 Fortitude save or take 1d4 points of Constitution drain. On each successful attack, the phantasm gains 3 temporary hit points. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Lifesense (Su)** A phantasm) notices and locates living creatures within 90 feet, just as if it possessed the blindsight ability.  

**Unnatural Aura (Su)** Animals do not willingly approach within 30 feet of a phantasm), unless a master makes a DC 25 Handle Animal, Ride, or wild empathy check.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** none
